title: File:Xian city wall guardhouse second story balcony.jpg

ObjectName.value: Xian city wall guardhouse second story balcony

Categories.value: City wall of Xi'an|License migration completed|Self-published work|GFDL-en

ImageDescription.value:
Photo of second story balcony of guardhouse atop Xi'an, China, city wall outer gate. Photo taken Richard Chambers, AAA Yangtze Sampler tour, May, 2004.

This photo provides an idea of the construction of the balcony which overlooks the courtyard between the inner and outer gate of the Xi'an city wall.

To reach the balcony, one must climb a stone staircase from the floor of the courtyard to the top of the city wall. This staircase can be seen to the left in the photo shown in the following link of the courtyard side of the outer gate.

See photo of the outer gate taken from the inner gate showing the courtyard and the guardhouse atop the outer gate.

Once atop the city wall, you can walk into the ground floor of the guardhouse and climb a stairway from the ground floor to the second story of the guardhouse from which the balcony can be reached.

See photo taken from balcony end showing exterior of the city wall and moat.

title: File:Xian city wall guardhouse second story interior.jpg

ObjectName.value: Xian city wall guardhouse second story interior

Categories.value: City wall of Xi'an|License migration completed|Self-published work|GFDL-en

ImageDescription.value:
Photo of interior second floor, city gate guardhouse of Xi'an, China. Photo taken Richard Chambers, AAA Yangtze Sampler tour, May 2004.

The seconf story of the guardhouse is reached by climbing the stone stairs from the interior courtyard between the inner and outer gates to the top of the wall. Then walk into the first story of the guardhouse which now contains souvenir shopping sections within the large open area of the first floor. The ceiling of the first floor is five or six meters above the floor with large posts within the interior supporting the upper structure of the guardhouse. After stepping in the doorway, walk towards the left and there is a stairway against the wall which can be climbed to the second story.

When you reach the top, you will see this view. On the second story there was a second souvenir shop displaying its wares on tables.

The ceiling is uncomfortably low with the exposed beams invoking a dread of a bump on the head for a taller person.

See photo of outer gate with wooden guardhouse to see an exterior view of the guardhouse as seen from the courtyard.

See photo of the balcony.

See photo taken from second floor balcony overlooking courtyard showing outside wall and moat.

title: File:Xian city wall inner gate looking outside.jpg

ObjectName.value: Xian city wall inner gate looking outside

Categories.value: City wall of Xi'an|License migration completed|Self-published work|GFDL-en

ImageDescription.value:
View of the Xi'an, China, city wall outer gate taken while standing in the inner gate showing the courtyard and part of the guardhouse atop the outer gate. Photo taken Richard Chambers, AAA Yangtze Sampler tour, May, 2004.

This photograph, taken while standing in the inner gate, shows a view of the courtyard between inner and outer gate and the wooden guardhouse built on top of the outer gate.

The inner gate is build in line with the city wall. The courtyard protrudes from the city wall so that the outer gate is outside of the wall though attached to it with the wall surrounding the courtyard.

See photo taken standing in the inner gate looking inside the wall towards the Bell Tower to see what was the Forbidden City when Xi'an was the capital of China but is now a bustling modern city.

See photo taken from the second story of the wooden gatehouse on the outer gate which shows a view of the exterior of the Xi'an city wall and the moat surrounding the wall. The area between moat and city wall has been turned into a lovely park area.
